notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h1]Corrections :[/h1]
[list]
[*] The words "[b]new[/b]" no longer appear on merchant runes
[*] The [b]Mercenary#2[/b] no longer has a [i]"hit"[/i] animation when taking [b]wound damage[/b]
[/list]

[h1]Balance :[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Rune CONTROL[/b] : [i]"Cumulative aura"[/i] increased amount of aura [b](6->7)[/b]
[*] [b]Rune BLOOD[/b] : [i]"Resonant attack"[/i] increased damage [b](25% -> 30 %)[/b]
[*] [b]Ability CONTROL[/b] : [i]"Safe materialization"[/i] increased aura gain [b](10 -> 12)[/b]
[*] [b]Ability CONTROL[/b] : [i]"Safe materialization"[/i] cost reduction [b](5 -> 4)[/b]
[*] [b]Talent NATURE[/b] : [i]+1 wound when a wound is applied[/i] -> [b](+3 wound)[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Bug fixes :[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed crash caused by Mystic endchain action and game speed at 400%
[*] The “activation” ability correctly triggers BRAVE talents #1 and #2
[*] It is no longer possible to place runes on locked chain slots [i](specific case with a full hand and a rune that cannot be placed in the last position)[/i]
[*] Mobs' attack speed now matches game speed [i](useful for 400%)[/i]
[*] Mobs are correctly replaced after using the “temporality” rune if a mob has been destroyed.
[*] Fix “Presence” passive mob, which now correctly considers physical and magical damage
[/list]

[h1]Additions :[/h1]
[list]
[*] In-game display of a “new” mention under runes/abilities/talents that are not in your library [i](that you've never chosen before)[/i]
[*] The “Ctrl” shortcut to disable/enable damage preview is now active only in battle or in options. This will limit the number of times this key is pressed by mistake, leaving players without a preview, and unaware that the option has been disabled.
[*] The 1st chain slot will always be the last to be locked [i](offers more playability, especially with runes that exhaust the next slot's rune)[/i]
[*] Visual update of some achievements (on STEAM)
[/list]

[h1]Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]BLOOD rune : "[i]Runic wound[/i]"[/b] increased number of wounds per rune in hand [b](3 -> 4)[/b]
[*] [b]MYSTIC rune : "[i]Runic shock[/i]"[/b] increased damage [b](30 -> 40)[/b]
[*] [b]CONTROL rune : "[i]Runic aura[/i]"[/b] increased number of auras per rune in hand [b](3 -> 4)[/b]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]BRAVE ability : "[i]Breaking[/i]"[/b] cost reduction [b](6 -> 5)[/b]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Mob : [i]Archer Gormnoq[/i][/b] Reduced HP [b](145 -> 140)[/b]
[i](Allows more early game combos to destroy it in 1 turn, especially on room 2)[/i]
[/list]

notes.title: Chained Runes version 1.0
notes.content:
Today is the day !
It's finally time for the official release of Chained Runes.
For the first week of its release, the game will be at [b]-30%[/b].

For the curious and undecided, the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3164880/Chained_Runes_Demo?snr=1_7_15__13]DEMO[/url] is still available and will give you a good idea of what to expect.
